propose a $32 million class fund and $6 million in fees, for a $38 million total outlay.

evidence.agent: Ostrander Bell LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: The parties therefore agreed to the class fund and fee terms in the same counterproposal; attorneys’ fees were not discussed only after class relief had been agreed.
A modest counterproposal reallocating part of the same $38 million total from fees to class relief could increase direct class recovery
To direct more of the same overall budget to affected members, we propose increasing the class fund to $35 million and reducing fees to $3 million

summary: Fees were included by both sides in Round 1 and were negotiated before the class relief was settled. The transcript expressly links fee amounts and class relief through a reallocation of the same overall settlement budget toward the class. There is no clear evidence that class counsel prioritized firm fees over the class, that defense leveraged fee interests, that reverse-auction tactics occurred, or that the court declaration was misleading.
